liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Unlisted disc 1 track 12 is a redundant intro to the disc 2 opener and can be deleted [34]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Drums have thundering power here, and Jerry's guitar tones stand out [29]
- **Playin' In The Band Reprise** (1 review): Reviewer thinks the transition between the second and third verses was never played better; Jerry's guitar tones also stand out in the jam [29]
- Reviewer's favorite part of the show is Stephen Stills sitting in on this song [26]
- Reviewer finds Stills's vocals awful, with Jerry's ripping guitar jam seeming to cover them [33]
- Reviewer finds this song terrible, though the rest of the show has great moments [35]
- Reviewer considers Stills's guest appearance a low point in Dead history [36]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big RR Blues**: cut on the recording [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-04-17.132876.SBD.Keo.Flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1983-04-17.162894.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 26 songs; 187 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd83-04-17.sbd.fink.14941.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 3.38/5 by 33 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this soundboard muddy and multi-generation, and recommends the 3-mic mix as higher fidelity; Reviewer says this soundboard copy is not first generation; Reviewer finds this soundboard's sound poor, identical to an old cassette copy; the audience copy is slightly better [32][33][35]
- **gd1983-04-17.169154.E.Rutherford.NJ.sbd.brightman.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min [7]
- **gd83-04-17.rolfe.weiner.7317.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 24 songs; 190 min; rated 4.5/5 by 16 [11]. Said about its sound: Audience recording that captures all the instruments and the crowd atmosphere, unlike many soundboards; Reviewer calls this a good audience recording [27][36]

## Around the show

- Stephen Stills joined the band as a walk-on guest, lifting the energy of the show [31]
- Reviewer's first Dead show: a clear April night, standing on the floor in row 23 [37]
- Stills traded very fat guitar licks with Jerry, according to the reviewer [37]
- Stephen Stills guested on Love The One You're With and Not Fade Away [2]
- Stephen Stills joined the band for Love The One You're With and Not Fade Away [7]
- Reviewer ranks this cover among the two worst in Dead history, alongside a Get Back from SF [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-04-17.132876.SBD.Keo.Flac1644**: transferred by Keo; source: Soundboard Master Cassettes > Unk > Low Gen PCM Early 90's > Sony HG L750 Beta Tape > Sony SL2405 Beta VCR > Modified PCM601ESD > SPDIF > VX Pocket Emphasis… [1]. Also: Soundboard patched with Steve Hill's unknown master audience source; Transferred with a Nakamichi MR-1 into a Korg MR-1000 at 1-bit/5.6 MHz, then converted to 16/44 using AudioGate [1]
- **gd1983-04-17.162894.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics (15th row, center) > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [2]. Also: A Sennheiser 421 source from d5scott patches 5:22 of Drums and 0:14 of the Throwing Stones > Not Fade Away transition [2]
- **gd83-04-17.sbd.fink.14941.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD : MC > C > DAT > CDRExtraction and .shn encoding by Alan J Fink via EAC and MKW. Proper sector boundaries verified via shntool.Seeded to Etree by Alan J… [5]. Also: Exact generation of this soundboard copy is unknown, but it is not first generation; Reviewer says this soundboard is a multi-generation source, with a track list that doesn't match the files; Soundboard chain: cassette to cassette to DAT to CDR, extracted and shn-encoded by Alan J Fink, seeded in February 2003 [5][32][34]
- **gd1983-04-17.169154.E.Rutherford.NJ.sbd.brightman.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Candace Brightman; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 21, 2024; source: SBD > PCM Master > Cassette (TDK SA-X90) [7]
- **gd83-04-17.rolfe.weiner.7317.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: AudMC > DAT > CDWAV > SHN [11]. Also: Audience taping credited to Steve Rolfe [27]
